description: This file defines the TappingUserDictionary class, which extends UserDictionary and creates specialized AndroidUserDictionary and FallbackUserDictionary instances that incorporate a WordReadListener for tap events.

classes.name: TappingUserDictionary
classes.description: A specialized UserDictionary that uses a WordReadListener to handle tap events, creating custom AndroidUserDictionary and FallbackUserDictionary instances.

methods.name: TappingUserDictionary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TappingUserDictionary with context, locale, and a WordReadListener.

methods.name: createAndroidUserDictionary
methods.description: Creates an instance of TappedAndroidUserDictionary with the provided context, locale, and tap listener.

methods.name: createFallbackUserDictionary
methods.description: Creates an instance of TappedUserFallbackUserDictionary with the provided context, locale, and tap listener.
